messages:
donna-sales: Ping team — Prospect 'NorthBridge' requested a 2-week POC. Requirements: SAML SSO, SCIM user + group sync, group-to-role RBAC, enforced email-domain only invites. Need quick runbook + hosted vs dedicated pricing comparison.

cal-solutions: We support SAML 2.0 (IdP & SP-initiated). Request IdP metadata XML and public cert. Persistent NameID (email) preferred. We handle signed assertions (RSA-SHA256). Encrypted assertions available; on Hosted customers upload SP decryption key via Console.

rao-eng: SCIM: /scim/v2/Users and /scim/v2/Groups implemented. PATCH for group membership supported. Bulk create up to 150 users per call. Note: group changes are eventually consistent; role cache TTL ~30s on Hosted. For immediate effects recommend Dedicated.

mei-security: Security checklist: certificate thumbprint, required NameID format, whether assertions must be encrypted, SCIM auth method (OAuth bearer vs mTLS), token rotation cadence, IP allowlist needs. Domain verification options: DNS TXT preferred; we also support email challenge. Share our questionnaire link: https://redwood.ai/security/sso-scim.

cal-solutions: Pricing note: Hosted = base + per-active-user/month + provisioning metering; default SCIM rate limit 10 req/s tenant with burst. Dedicated = reserved capacity with provisioning allowance and predictable monthly. I'll draft worked examples for 50 and 500 users.

infra-bot: [automated] Created ticket NB-POC-664 and attached SAML/SCIM checklist.

donna-sales: Action items: @rao-eng create 1-page runbook (ACS URL, SP entityID, SAML attribute mapping, minimal SCIM JSON examples), @mei-security fill questionnaire answers, @cal-solutions draft pricing bullets. Target: 48hrs. I'll send to buyer once internal review done.
